title: Go Where the King Is Not
setup: Black's king has just dropped back to d8, leaving the whole kingside to White.
hint: The pawn on e6 needs its king next to it; work out which flank that king would take longest to reach.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Kf4}} heads for the wing Black has just left. {{Ke7}} {{Kg5}} {{Kf7}} {{Kh6}}, and the white king walks around through g6 and g7. Black cannot cover d7 and f7 at once, so e6 falls and the passed pawn queens. {{Kd4}} or {{Ke4}} instead lets Black hold everything.
